_meta.title: Compatibility compare/contrast primitives (Shared / Different / Watch / Try)
_meta.model: Per planet, each card composes four one-line lanes: Shared (from the two signs' element/relationship), Different (each sign's trait clause), Watch (relationship-type risk), Try (relationship-type move). traits.diff = clause for different-sign cards; traits.same = plural predicate for same-sign cards.
_meta.provenance: Sign trait clauses condensed from Marie Satori, 'As Above, So Below' (2023) — her verbatim per-sign Moon/Mercury/Venus descriptions — plus cc-planet-in-sign-reviewed. Voiced-original condensations of her words; tier voiced-original-grounded, DRAFT pending sign-off. NOT served as verbatim Marie.

moon.function: The Moon rules your emotions, your intuition, and the subconscious. It shows how each of you feels, soothes, and needs care.
moon.nouns: emotional needs, comfort habits, private reactions

aries.same: feel fast and fiery, quick to act on a mood

taurus.diff: Taurus feels deeply and grounds in comfort, stability, and the senses
taurus.same: settle through comfort, stability, and steadiness

gemini.diff: Gemini feels in quick, changeable shifts and needs to talk it out
gemini.same: process feelings by talking them out

cancer.diff: Cancer feels strongly and finds comfort in home, family, and the familiar
cancer.same: seek safety in home, family, and the familiar

leo.diff: Leo feels dramatically and needs warmth, recognition, and appreciation
leo.same: need warmth and recognition to feel okay

virgo.diff: Virgo feels practically and settles once things are handled
virgo.same: steady yourselves by handling the details

libra.diff: Libra feels balanced and needs fairness and harmony

capricorn.same: manage feelings through structure and self-control

aquarius.same: keep a cool, independent distance from your own feelings

pisces.diff: Pisces feels everything and soaks up the emotional weather around it
pisces.same: absorb the emotional weather and feel it all

shared.same_sign: You share the same emotional language, so you recognize each other fast.
shared.fire: Both fire Moons feel loudly and want to move the mood into action.
shared.earth: Both earth Moons steady themselves through the practical and real.
shared.air: Both air Moons need to understand a feeling before they can settle into it.
shared.water: Both water Moons read emotional tone quickly.
shared.cross: You both need to feel safe — you just reach for it differently.

watch.same_sign: You can amplify the same mood instead of balancing each other out.
watch.same_element: One person may go quiet while the other reaches for reassurance.
watch.opposition: Your comfort styles can feel like opposites pulling in two directions.
watch.complementary: The ease can let you skip saying what you actually need.
watch.friction: One runs hot or practical while the other needs depth or space.
watch.mixed: Your timing for comfort can be off — one soothes while the other wants to move on.

try.same_sign: When you're both low, let one of you name it out loud first.
try.same_element: Name whether you need space or comfort before reacting.
try.opposition: Treat the difference as two halves of care, not a verdict on who's right.
try.complementary: Keep naming what you need even when things feel smooth.
try.friction: Translate: name the feeling before fixing it or analyzing it.
try.mixed: Say what would actually settle you instead of assuming the other knows.

moon.same_house: You share the sign and the house, so your inner emotional lives play out in the same part of life. You are deeply in tune, which feels safe, but it also means you mirror each other's moods instead of balancing them. Watch for feeding the same fear or sinking into the same feeling together. When you are both caught in it, look outside the two of you for a different emotional perspective.
moon.same_sign: You share the same inner emotional world, so you feel understood without having to explain yourself. You need the same things to feel safe, and you soothe yourselves the same way. The risk is that you drop into the same mood at the same time, and neither of you is in a different enough place to lift the other out of it. When you are both low, agree that one of you names the feeling out loud first.

same_sign_quote.text: You can't do everything alone anymore. At least not without it breaking you.

verdict.same_sign: You read each other's moods without a word.
verdict.same_element: You need the same things emotionally, and it comes easy.
verdict.complementary: Your feelings just track each other.
verdict.opposition: Your emotional needs run opposite, but they can balance if you let them.
verdict.friction: You keep missing each other emotionally, and someone ends up feeling unseen.
verdict.mixed: Your emotional timing rarely lines up, but it can with real effort.

mercury.same_house: You share the sign and the house, so you think alike about the same parts of life. That makes for easy agreement, but also a shared blind spot in exactly the area you talk about most. You can be certain together and both be wrong. Pressure-test your conclusions with someone who thinks differently.
mercury.same_sign: You think the same way, so you follow each other easily and rarely have to over-explain. Conversation is quick and it feels like shorthand. The risk is an echo chamber, where you confirm each other instead of challenging each other. Deliberately bring in the view neither of you would reach on your own.

venus.same_house: You share the sign and the house, so love and worth show up in the same part of your lives. You match closely, which feels effortless, but it can also mean you share the same insecurity with no one to soften it. Do not let the ease keep you from tending the connection. Choose each other on purpose, not only when it is easy.

The risk is that you both wait to be pursued, or you assume the other wants exactly what you want and never say it. Name what would actually feel like love out loud.

sun.same_house: You share the sign and the house, so this shows up in the exact same part of life. You are fully mirrored in who you are and where you put yourself forward. The recognition is instant, but there is no one to balance the pattern, so it doubles instead of rounding out. Take turns leading, and look outside the two of you for perspective on this area, because neither of you will naturally provide it.
sun.same_sign: You share the same core identity, so you recognize each other fast. You lead the same way and shine in the same kind of room, and you understand what drives the other without it being explained. The catch is that you also share the same blind spot, and neither of you brings an outside angle to it. Let each of you lead where you are genuinely strongest instead of competing for the same attention.

mars.same_house: You share the sign and the house, so your drive and your conflicts land in the same part of life. You push in sync, which is powerful, but it also means you escalate the same way at the same time. When you both get heated, no one is the calm one. Agree on how you will cool down before you need to.
mars.same_sign: You go after what you want the same way, so you understand each other's drive and can build real momentum together. The risk is two matching tempers colliding with nothing to absorb the shock, or both charging in the same direction and missing what you run past. Aim the shared energy at a goal, not at each other.

same_house_quote.text: Stop calling it stress when it's actually rage being suppressed.

verdict.opposition: Your drives pull opposite ways: electric, or a standoff.

shared.air: Both air Jupiters grow through ideas, people, and perspective.

watch.opposition: Your beliefs about what matters can pull apart.
watch.complementary: The easy encouragement can drift without a plan.
watch.friction: One wants to leap while the other wants proof.
watch.mixed: Your ideas of growth can point different ways.

jupiter.same_house: You share the sign and the house, so you both expand in the same part of life. That brings a lot of faith and momentum, and also a shared tendency to overdo it in the exact same place. Watch for over-promising or over-reaching together. Stay realistic while you chase the bigger thing.
jupiter.same_sign: You believe in the same things and reach for the same kind of growth, so you encourage each other easily and dream in the same direction. The risk is doubling the optimism and skipping the practical step, or reinforcing the same bias with no one to question it. Let one of you be the grounded check, and turn the shared vision into one concrete move.

verdict.same_sign: You chase growth in the same direction, and it clicks.
verdict.same_element: You grow and dream on the same lines.
verdict.complementary: You blow each other's worlds open.
verdict.opposition: You grow opposite ways: it widens you, or splits you.
verdict.friction: What you believe and reach for keeps rubbing wrong.
verdict.mixed: You grow in different ways, but there is real learning here.

saturn.same_house: You share the sign and the house, so the same area of life is where you both feel the pressure to prove yourself. You understand each other's weight, which is a comfort, but you can also pile it on in the exact same place. Watch for turning support into shared hardness. Lighten the load for each other instead of matching it.
saturn.same_sign: You carry the same lesson, so you take each other's responsibilities seriously and understand each other's fears without explanation. The risk is reinforcing the same limit or fear instead of easing it, and getting heavy together. Be the one who reminds the other it is allowed to be enough, and do not let discipline become a contest over who has it harder.

same_sign_quote.text: Stop wearing burnout like a badge of honor. It's just burnout.
